text: Been on hold 40 mins so texting instead. Minding a 4yo girl tonight, parents away till tomorrow. She's had a temp on and off but between the calpol and nurofen she's been fine, running round, drinking her juice, chatting away. Now there's these little dark dots come up on her tummy and back. I pressed a glass on them like you're supposed to and they're still there, plain as anything. And she won't put her chin down. I asked her to look at her belly button and she just wouldn't, keeps her head up. Can someone actually ring me back please
